about.title: About
about.hook: I build multilingual web platforms that scale — from <highlight>B2B product catalogs</highlight> to <highlight>digital menus</highlight>.
about.p2: Currently, I lead the web presence for <highlight>Tüzemen Textile</highlight>, where I built and maintain their official platform from the ground up while also managing international sales and logistics. Alongside this, I manage the full project lifecycle for applications like <highlight>Menupedia</highlight> and <highlight>Hastory</highlight>, and have maintained the web presence for the Finnish organization <highlight>Hangflow</highlight> for over two years.
about.p3: My certifications from <highlight>Meta</highlight> and <highlight>Google</highlight> shape my analytical approach to engineering. I always focus on building projects that scale and communicate across languages and borders.
